description: List every exchange configured on Autoview, filterable by paper (testnet/practice/sim, no real money), free (no Autoview subscription required), and name. Every listed exchange works with entry, command, alert and connect once its credentials are linked to one of your hooks (the exchange itself validates the order); linkable ones also take paper keys via link -- see connect_url to add credentials for one. Pass exchange (any spelling of its id, e.g. "OANDAPRACTICE") to get that one exchange in detail instead of the list: credentials is a JSON Schema whose property keys are exactly the keys link takes (titles are the exchange's own labels, required lists the ones it needs), plus linkable and unsupported_parameters (command parameters the exchange rejects, e.g. sl/tp; an attached bracket using one is refused up front). Requires your Autoview account token.

exchange.description: one exchange id (any spelling, e.g. "OANDAPRACTICE" or "oanda-practice") to get its credential schema and facts instead of the list; paper/free/name are ignored when this is set

free.description: filter to (true) or exclude (false) exchanges that need no Autoview subscription; omit for both

name.description: case-insensitive substring match against the exchange's display name or id, e.g. "binance"

paper.description: filter to (true) or exclude (false) paper/testnet/sim exchanges; omit for both

token.description: your Autoview account token — an av_mcp_ personal access token, generate one at /account/tokens/ on the Autoview site. Omit this if your MCP client already sends it as an `Authorization: Bearer` header (Claude Code, Cursor, and most non-browser clients do this automatically once configured).

name: catalog
